# Data Dictionary

**All data is synthetic**, generated by `src/generate_data.py` (seed 42). It mimics an Archtics season ticket export for **New York Knicks home games at Madison Square Garden** (2025–26). Members are mostly from New York, then New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Vermont. It is messy, inconsistent, and spread across two systems.

## ticket_activity_2025_26.csv
25,000 rows, **one row per account per event** (917 accounts, 41 Knicks home games + 8 MSG concerts).

| Column | Meaning | Known mess |
|---|---|---|
| Account_ID | Account number (ACCT######) | Join key to renewals |
| Name | Account holder | Mixed case, "Last, First", extra spaces, blanks, can differ across rows |
| Email | Contact email | Blanks, uppercase, typos, missing "@", trailing spaces |
| Age | Age in years | Text ("34.0", "34 yrs", "unknown", "N/A"), blanks, impossible values (0, -1, 999) |
| Location | City/state or ZIP (NYC boroughs, Westchester/Long Island, NJ, upstate NY, PA, VT) | Several formats, "NYC"/"Manhattan", full state names, ZIP only, blanks |
| Account_Type | Individual or Corporate | Case, blanks |
| Member_Since | First season as a member | Blanks |
| Event_Name | e.g. "Knicks Home Game 07 vs Celtics", "Concert - Neon Harbor" | Uppercase, "NYK HG07" shorthand |
| Event_Type | Game or Concert | Case, blanks |
| Event_Date | Date of event | Four date formats, blanks |
| Section, Row, Seat_Numbers | Seat location | Bowl = MSG 100 level (101–120), Balcony = 200 level (201–227) |
| Num_Seats | Seats on the account | Blanks |
| Price_Code | Price level + plan suffix. Bowl A–Z (A = priciest), Balcony 17–30. `_F` Full Season, `_H` Half, `_Q` Quarter | Lowercase, "-" instead of "_", trailing spaces |
| Ticket_Type | Full Season / Half / Quarter | Blanks, ~1% disagree with Price_Code |
| Price_Per_Seat | Per-game price (about $65–$750) | "$405.00", "405.0", "405", blanks |
| Payment_Plan | Pay in Full, 3 Way, 5-6 Month, 12 Monthly | Many spellings ("PIF", "3-Pay", "Monthly (12)"), blanks |
| Payment_Status | **Account-level** billing standing on the season budget, repeated on every row: Green = paid in full, Yellow = partially paid / behind on plan, Red = has not paid | Case, "Grn"/"Yel", spaces, blanks |
| Seat_Status | RE resold, P posted for resale, F forwarded, O out for forward, D donated, blank = kept by holder | Lowercase, "N/A", "-", " " also mean kept |
| Tickets_Scanned | Seats scanned at the gate | Blanks |
| Resale_Price | Price per seat when resold | Only on RE rows, "$" sometimes |
| Rep_Code | Service rep | Mostly blank, case |
| Notes | Rep notes | Almost always blank |
| Unnamed: 23 | Export artifact | Entirely empty: drop it |

About 1% of rows are exact duplicates.

## renewals_2026_27.csv
One row per account: did they renew for 2026–27?

| Column | Meaning | Known mess |
|---|---|---|
| Account_ID | Join key | ~2% lowercase; ~3% of accounts missing from this file |
| Renewal_Status | Renewed / Cancelled | "Y", "Yes", "RENEWED", "Canceled", "N", etc. |
| Cancellation_Reason | Why they cancelled | **Leakage trap:** only known after the decision. Never use as a feature. |
| Processed_Date | When renewal was processed | Also after the decision. Don't use as a feature. |

## Recommended table split
The export mixes grains. Split it into tables joined on keys:

| Table | One row per | Key |
|---|---|---|
| accounts | account | Account_ID |
| plans | account | Account_ID |
| events | event | Event_Name |
| attendance | account × event | Account_ID + Event_Name |
| renewals | account | Account_ID |

## Cleaning checklist
1. Drop `Unnamed: 23` and exact duplicates.
2. Standardize case and whitespace; map Payment_Plan, Payment_Status, Seat_Status and Renewal_Status variants to one value each.
3. Parse Age to numeric; set impossible ages to missing.
4. Parse all four date formats; strip "$" from prices.
5. Fill Ticket_Type from the Price_Code suffix when blank.
6. **Aggregate to one row per account** (resale rate, no-show rate, % Red events, concerts bought, etc.), then join to renewals.
